import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', order=df['Education'].value_counts().index)
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Spending categories comparison
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_means = df[spending_cols].mean()
spending_means.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(spending_cols))))
ax2.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Amount Spent ($)', fontsize=12)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Purchase channels distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].sum()
purchase_data.plot(kind='pie', ax=ax3, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, 
                   colors=['#ff9999','#66b3ff','#99ff99'])
ax3.set_title('Purchase Distribution by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('')

# 4. Income vs Total Spending scatter plot
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='TotalSpending', hue='Kidhome', 
                size='Teenhome', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.6, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Income vs Total Spending (Colored by Kids at Home)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(title='Kidhome', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 5. Campaign acceptance rates
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_acceptance = df[campaign_cols].mean() * 100
campaign_acceptance.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=plt.cm.Paired(np.arange(len(campaign_cols))))
ax5.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Campaign', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax5.set_ylim(0, 100)

# 6. Recency distribution by marital status
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='Marital_Status', y='Recency', 
               order=df['Marital_Status'].value_counts().index)
ax6.set_title('Days Since Last Purchase by Marital Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Days Since Last Purchase', fontsize=12)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. Age distribution histogram
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']  # Assuming current year is 2024
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax7)
ax7.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)

# 8. Web visits vs web purchases
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
sns.regplot(data=df, x='NumWebVisitsMonth', y='NumWebPurchases', 
            scatter_kws={'alpha':0.5}, line_kws={'color':'red'}, ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Web Visits vs Web Purchases', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Monthly Web Visits', fontsize=12)
ax8.set_ylabel('Web Purchases', fontsize=12)

# 9. Deal purchases by income quartile
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
df['Income_Quartile'] = pd.qcut(df['Income'], 4, labels=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Income_Quartile', y='NumDealsPurchases', 
            order=['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4'])
ax9.set_title('Deal Purchases by Income Quartile', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Income Quartile', fontsize=12)
ax9.set_ylabel('Number of Deal Purchases', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
